title_line: SabreNdc / EGY - TestCases_V2.csv (V2 flows and endpoint cases) - Round 2
scope_text: Round 2 - 212 test cases from TestCases_V2.csv (192 flow rows: FareConfirm-based 25-72, Upselling-based 73-120; 20 endpoint cases): SabreNdc / EGY on staging
description_text: Round 2 of the V2 flows and V2-only endpoint cases, run against SabreNdc with the EGY credentials selector (flight date 2026-11-24). SabreNdc supports no bundles, ancillaries or seat maps (re-confirmed at the start of this round), so those enrichment flows are reported as blocked. Each row records its Round 1 verdict.

steps: Re-ran the SPEC 4.7 capability confirmation before opening Round 2: V2 Search on 6 routes (CAI-JED, CAI-DOH, DOH-CAI, CAI-DXB, JED-CAI, CAI-LHR, 2026-11-24) for SabreNdc/EGY read the per-offer flags on all 91 offers: haveBundles, offerHasAncillary, offerHasSeat and isSeatMapRequired are false on every offer, canBeHeld is true on every offer.
FareConfirm re-confirmed the same flags on the selected offer.

Called Upselling (V1 + V2), GetOfferBundles (V1 + V2), AddPassenger, GetAncillary, GetSeatMap and FareCheck once each: Upselling returns 200 (V2: 6 upsell offers), GetOfferBundles, GetAncillary, GetSeatMap and FareCheck all return 409 OperationNotSupported ("SabreNdc does not exists") - identical to Round 1.
Concluded that the Bundle, Ancillary and SeatMap enrichment flows are still blocked and that only the no-enrichment families (A-F, FareConfirm and Upselling paths) run.
